record_type_quote: An association between a polymorphic ApaLI site within the porphobilinogen deaminase (PBGD) gene and schizophrenia has been reported recently. In order to replicate this finding we examined the ApaLI RFLP, which is located in intron 1 of the PBGD gene, in 93 unrelated patients who met the DSM-III-R criteria for schizophrenia versus 74 unrelated controls.

targets.outcome_quote: An association between a polymorphic ApaLI site within the porphobilinogen deaminase (PBGD) gene and schizophrenia has been reported recently. In order to replicate this finding we examined the ApaLI RFLP, which is located in intron 1 of the PBGD gene, in 93 unrelated patients who met the DSM-III-R criteria for schizophrenia versus 74 unrelated controls. There were no significant differences between the groups in allele frequencies or genotype counts.
